steps.note: Send an HTTP request to $DATA_URL with $API_KEY in the Authorization header.

must_not: Replacing $DATA_URL with the page's sample https://api.example.com/data; the request goes to whatever secrets.env holds.
Writing or overwriting secrets.env; the page assumes it already exists.
scaffolding: secrets.env at the workspace root holds API_KEY and DATA_URL, as the page assumes. DATA_URL points at the local echo API.
